description: Klaviyo PERFORMANCE for campaigns (default) or flows (of:'flows'): recipients, delivered, unique opens and open rate, unique clicks and click rate, conversions and conversion rate, REVENUE (conversion_value) and revenue per recipient, unsubscribes, bounces and spam complaints, per campaign (or per flow message), over timeframe (last_7_days, last_30_days default, last_90_days, this_month, last_12_months...) or start + end (at most a year). Conversions and revenue count on conversionMetric (default 'Placed Order'). Narrow with campaignIds / flowIds or channel. Rates are fractions (0.25 = 25%). Klaviyo allows only 2 report queries a minute and 225 a day, so ask once with a wide window; the same question within 10 minutes is answered from the last read unless fresh:true. Read-only, free. Needs Klaviyo connected (Connectors > Klaviyo, or connect_connector with a private API key).

conversionMetric.description: metric name or id; default 'Placed Order'

statistics.description: Klaviyo statistic names, e.g. opens_unique, click_rate, conversion_value

name: klaviyo_report
title: Klaviyo campaign and flow performance
